status: empirical analytic-flow illustration; not interval certified or a proof
semantics: x_prime=v;v_prime=a;a_prime=r*(u-a);fixed r per run. Direct u=clip(-x-3v-2a,-1,1) sampled every hold from time0. Backup holds u=-1 until T then restarts the same sampled feedback clock at T. No state reset.
errors: zero measurement, quantization, disturbance, command and timing error in both phases; exact model with floating-point evaluation
physical_example_only: If nominal tau0=.1s, T=1.25 is125ms and horizon20 is2s. All reported states/time are normalized, not calibrated hardware.

metric_notes.peak_abs_travel: numerical extrema of analytic held segments (velocity roots bisected60 times); not a rigorously rounded upper bound
metric_notes.sampled_peak_V: evaluated on elapsed grids at most dt apart plus segment endpoints and T
metric_notes.post_T_sampled_peak_V: same window [T,horizon] in both methods; includes T
metric_notes.terminal_V: at exactly T=1.25 for both methods, even if T lies between direct-controller updates
metric_notes.command_switches: adjacent held values differing by more than1e-12; not a performance objective by itself
metric_notes.comparison_scope: 24 pairs, corners and3 rates only; no interior, jitter, error or parameter-grid safety inference

refinement_check.interpretation: sampling sensitivity diagnostic, not an error bound
